title: Exact value of the site-percolation threshold on the square lattice
exact_target: What is the exact critical probability at which independent site percolation on the square lattice can produce an infinite open cluster?

sources.citation: Jesper Lykke Jacobsen, Critical points of Potts and O(N) models from eigenvalue identities in periodic Temperley-Lieb algebras, 2015, Section 1(ii) and Eq. (2).
